description: Defines classes and structures for encoding, decoding, and representing Binary HTTP messages, including requests and responses, with support for headers, trailers, and informational responses.

classes.name: BinaryHttpMessage
classes.description: Base class supporting encoding and decoding of Binary HTTP messages, managing headers, body, and padding.

classes.name: BinaryHttpMessage::Field
classes.description: Represents a name-value pair for headers or trailers.

classes.name: BinaryHttpRequest
classes.description: Represents a Binary HTTP request with control data such as method, scheme, authority, and path.

classes.name: BinaryHttpResponse
classes.description: Represents a Binary HTTP response with status code and informational responses.

classes.name: BinaryHttpResponse::InformationalResponse
classes.description: Represents an informational response within a Binary HTTP response, including status code and headers.

classes.name: BinaryHttpRequest::ControlData
classes.description: Holds control data for a request, including method, scheme, authority, and path.

methods.name: AddHeaderField
methods.description: Adds a header or trailer field to the message.

methods.name: GetHeaderFields
methods.description: Returns the list of header fields.

methods.name: set_body
methods.description: Sets the body of the message.

methods.name: swap_body
methods.description: Swaps the current body with another string.

methods.name: set_num_padding_bytes
methods.description: Sets the number of padding bytes.

methods.name: num_padding_bytes
methods.description: Returns the number of padding bytes.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Returns the body as a string view.

methods.name: EncodedSize
methods.description: Returns the size in bytes of the serialized message.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the message into a string.

methods.name: DebugString
methods.description: Returns a debug string representation of the message.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a message object from serialized data.

methods.name: IsPayloadEqual
methods.description: Checks equality of payload excluding padding.
